#include <chrono>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cstring>
#include <vector>

#include "../common/results_output.hpp"

constexpr double SOFTENING = 1e-9;
constexpr double DT = 0.01;

struct Vec3 {
    double x, y, z;
    constexpr Vec3(const double x = 0, const double y = 0, const double z = 0) noexcept : x(x), y(y), z(z) {}
};

struct Body {
    Vec3 pos;
    Vec3 vel;
};

void randomizeBodies(std::vector<Body>& bodies, unsigned int seed = 42) {
    for (auto& body : bodies) {
        body.pos.x = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;
        body.pos.y = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;
        body.pos.z = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;
        body.vel.x = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;
        body.vel.y = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;
        body.vel.z = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;
    }
}

void computeForces(std::vector<Body>& bodies) {
    const size_t n = bodies.size();
    
    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        double Fx = 0.0, Fy = 0.0, Fz = 0.0;
        
        for (size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
            const double dx = bodies[j].pos.x - bodies[i].pos.x;
            const double dy = bodies[j].pos.y - bodies[i].pos.y;
            const double dz = bodies[j].pos.z - bodies[i].pos.z;
            const double distSqr = dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + SOFTENING;
            const double invDist = 1.0 / std::sqrt(distSqr);
            const double invDist3 = invDist * invDist * invDist;
            
            Fx += dx * invDist3;
            Fy += dy * invDist3;
            Fz += dz * invDist3;
        }
        
        bodies[i].vel.x += DT * Fx;
        bodies[i].vel.y += DT * Fy;
        bodies[i].vel.z += DT * Fz;
    }
}

void integrateBodies(std::vector<Body>& bodies) {
    for (auto& body : bodies) {
        body.pos.x += body.vel.x * DT;
        body.pos.y += body.vel.y * DT;
        body.pos.z += body.vel.z * DT;
    }
}

double computeTotalEnergy(const std::vector<Body>& bodies) {
    double energy = 0.0;
    const size_t n = bodies.size();
    
    // Kinetic energy (assuming unit mass)
    for (const auto& body : bodies) {
        energy += 0.5 * (body.vel.x * body.vel.x + 
                        body.vel.y * body.vel.y + 
                        body.vel.z * body.vel.z);
    }
    
    // Potential energy (assuming unit mass for all bodies)
    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        for (size_t j = i + 1; j < n; ++j) {
            const double dx = bodies[j].pos.x - bodies[i].pos.x;
            const double dy = bodies[j].pos.y - bodies[i].pos.y;
            const double dz = bodies[j].pos.z - bodies[i].pos.z;
            const double dist = std::sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + SOFTENING);
            energy -= 1.0 / dist;
        }
    }
    
    return energy;
}

// Validate that simulation produces finite, reasonable values
bool validateSimulation(const std::vector<Body>& bodies) {
    for (const auto& body : bodies) {
        // Check for NaN or Inf values
        if (!std::isfinite(body.pos.x) || !std::isfinite(body.pos.y) || !std::isfinite(body.pos.z) ||
            !std::isfinite(body.vel.x) || !std::isfinite(body.vel.y) || !std::isfinite(body.vel.z)) {
            printf("Validation failed: found NaN or Inf value in body state\n");
            return false;
        }
        
        // Check for extreme values (bodies shouldn't fly off to infinity)
        const double maxPos = 1e6;
        const double maxVel = 1e6;
        if (std::abs(body.pos.x) > maxPos || std::abs(body.pos.y) > maxPos || std::abs(body.pos.z) > maxPos) {
            printf("Validation failed: body position exceeds reasonable bounds\n");
            return false;
        }
        if (std::abs(body.vel.x) > maxVel || std::abs(body.vel.y) > maxVel || std::abs(body.vel.z) > maxVel) {
            printf("Validation failed: body velocity exceeds reasonable bounds\n");
            return false;
        }
    }
    return true;
}

void printUsage(const char* progName) {
    printf("Usage: %s [options]\n", progName);
    printf("Options:\n");
    printf("  -n <num>     Number of bodies (default: 1024)\n");
    printf("  -s <num>     Number of simulation steps (default: 10)\n");
    printf("  -v           Enable validation (checks energy conservation)\n");
    printf("  -r           Print results for external validation\n");
    printf("  -h           Show this help message\n");
}

int main(int argc, char** argv) {
    int numBodies = 1024;
    int numSteps = 10;
    bool validate = false;
    bool printResults = false;
    
    // Parse command line arguments
    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {
        if (strcmp(argv[i], "-n") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {
            numBodies = atoi(argv[++i]);
        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], "-s") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {
            numSteps = atoi(argv[++i]);
        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], "-v") == 0) {
            validate = true;
        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], "-r") == 0) {
            printResults = true;
        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], "-h") == 0) {
            printUsage(argv[0]);
            return 0;
        } else {
            printf("Unknown option: %s\n", argv[i]);
            printUsage(argv[0]);
            return 1;
        }
    }
    
    printf("N-Body Simulation\n");
    printf("Number of bodies: %d\n", numBodies);
    printf("Number of steps: %d\n", numSteps);
    printf("Validation: %s\n", validate ? "enabled" : "disabled");
    
    // Initialize bodies
    std::vector<Body> bodies(numBodies);
    randomizeBodies(bodies);
    
    // Run simulation
    auto start = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();
    
    for (int step = 0; step < numSteps; ++step) {
        computeForces(bodies);
        integrateBodies(bodies);
    }
    
    auto end = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();
    auto duration = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(end - start);
    
    printf("Simulation time: %ld ms\n", duration.count());
    
    // Print results for external validation
    if (printResults) {
        // Serialize body positions and velocities for hashing
        std::vector<double> bodyData;
        bodyData.reserve(numBodies * 6);
        for (const auto& body : bodies) {
            bodyData.push_back(body.pos.x);
            bodyData.push_back(body.pos.y);
            bodyData.push_back(body.pos.z);
            bodyData.push_back(body.vel.x);
            bodyData.push_back(body.vel.y);
            bodyData.push_back(body.vel.z);
        }
        print_results(bodyData, "Bodies");
    }
    
    // Validation: check that simulation produces finite, reasonable values
    if (validate) {
        printf("Validating simulation results...\n");
        
        if (validateSimulation(bodies)) {
            // Report final energy for reference
            double finalEnergy = computeTotalEnergy(bodies);
            printf("Final energy: %.6f\n", finalEnergy);
            printf("Validation: PASSED\n");
            return 0;
        } else {
            printf("Validation: FAILED\n");
            return 1;
        }
    }
    
    return 0;
}

#pragma once

#include <cstdint>

// FNV-1a hash, 64 bit length
class hash {
  public:
	using digest = uint64_t;

	template <typename T>
	void add(const T& value) {
		const unsigned char* bytes = reinterpret_cast<const unsigned char*>(&value);
		for(size_t i = 0; i < sizeof(T); ++i) {
			d = (d ^ bytes[i]) * 0x100000001b3ull;
		}
	}

	digest get() const { return d; }

  private:
	digest d = 0xcbf29ce484222325ull;
};
#pragma once

#include <algorithm>
#include <cinttypes>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdio>
#include <vector>

#include "hash.hpp"

// Kahan summation for numerically stable sum
template <typename T>
T kahan_sum(const std::vector<T>& data) {
    T sum = 0.0;
    T c = 0.0;
    for (const auto& val : data) {
        T y = val - c;
        T t = sum + y;
        c = (t - sum) - y;
        sum = t;
    }
    return sum;
}

// Print results for floating-point arrays
template <typename T>
void print_results(const std::vector<T>& data, const char* name = "Result") {
    if (data.empty()) {
        printf("=== RESULTS ===\n");
        printf("Name: %s\n", name);
        printf("Elements: 0\n");
        printf("=== END RESULTS ===\n");
        return;
    }

    const size_t N = data.size();
    
    // Compute statistics
    T sum = kahan_sum(data);
    T min_val = data[0];
    T max_val = data[0];
    for (const auto& val : data) {
        min_val = std::min(min_val, val);
        max_val = std::max(max_val, val);
    }
    
    // Compute hash
    hash h;
    for (const auto& val : data) {
        h.add(val);
    }
    
    // Sample indices: 0, N/4, N/2, 3N/4, N-1
    size_t indices[5] = {0, N/4, N/2, 3*N/4, N-1};
    
    printf("=== RESULTS ===\n");
    printf("Name: %s\n", name);
    printf("Elements: %zu\n", N);
    printf("Sum: %.17e\n", static_cast<double>(sum));
    printf("Min: %.17e\n", static_cast<double>(min_val));
    printf("Max: %.17e\n", static_cast<double>(max_val));
    for (int i = 0; i < 5; ++i) {
        printf("Sample[%zu]: %.17e\n", indices[i], static_cast<double>(data[indices[i]]));
    }
    printf("Hash: %016" PRIx64 "\n", h.get());
    printf("=== END RESULTS ===\n");
}

// Print results for integer arrays (uses exact hash comparison)
template <typename T>
void print_results_int(const std::vector<T>& data, const char* name = "Result") {
    if (data.empty()) {
        printf("=== RESULTS ===\n");
        printf("Name: %s\n", name);
        printf("Elements: 0\n");
        printf("=== END RESULTS ===\n");
        return;
    }

    const size_t N = data.size();
    
    // Compute hash
    hash h;
    for (const auto& val : data) {
        h.add(val);
    }
    
    // Compute min/max
    T min_val = data[0];
    T max_val = data[0];
    for (const auto& val : data) {
        min_val = std::min(min_val, val);
        max_val = std::max(max_val, val);
    }
    
    // Sample indices: 0, N/4, N/2, 3N/4, N-1
    size_t indices[5] = {0, N/4, N/2, 3*N/4, N-1};
    
    printf("=== RESULTS ===\n");
    printf("Name: %s\n", name);
    printf("Elements: %zu\n", N);
    printf("Min: %lld\n", static_cast<long long>(min_val));
    printf("Max: %lld\n", static_cast<long long>(max_val));
    for (int i = 0; i < 5; ++i) {
        printf("Sample[%zu]: %lld\n", indices[i], static_cast<long long>(data[indices[i]]));
    }
    printf("Hash: %016" PRIx64 "\n", h.get());
    printf("=== END RESULTS ===\n");
}

    Vec3 vel;
};

void randomizeBodies(std::vector<Body>& bodies, unsigned int seed = 42) {
    for (auto& body : bodies) {
        body.pos.x = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;
        body.pos.y = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;
        body.pos.z = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;
        body.vel.x = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;
        body.vel.y = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;
        body.vel.z = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;
    }
}

void computeForces(std::vector<Body>& bodies) {
    const size_t n = bodies.size();
    
    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        double Fx = 0.0, Fy = 0.0, Fz = 0.0;
        
        for (size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
            const double dx = bodies[j].pos.x - bodies[i].pos.x;
            const double dy = bodies[j].pos.y - bodies[i].pos.y;
            const double dz = bodies[j].pos.z - bodies[i].pos.z;
            const double distSqr = dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + SOFTENING;
            const double invDist = 1.0 / std::sqrt(distSqr);
            const double invDist3 = invDist * invDist * invDist;
            
            Fx += dx * invDist3;
            Fy += dy * invDist3;
            Fz += dz * invDist3;
        }
        
        bodies[i].vel.x += DT * Fx;
        bodies[i].vel.y += DT * Fy;
        bodies[i].vel.z += DT * Fz;
    }
}

void integrateBodies(std::vector<Body>& bodies) {
    for (auto& body : bodies) {
        body.pos.x += body.vel.x * DT;
        body.pos.y += body.vel.y * DT;

    }

double computeTotalEnergy(const std::vector<Body>& bodies) {
    double energy = 0.0;
    const size_t n = bodies.size();
    
    // Kinetic energy (assuming unit mass)
    for (const auto& body : bodies) {
        energy += 0.5 * (body.vel.x * body.vel.x + 
                        body.vel.y * body.vel.y + 
                        body.vel.z * body.vel.z);
    }
    
    // Potential energy (assuming unit mass for all bodies)

            bodyData.push_back(body.vel.z);
        }
        print_results(bodyData, "Bodies");
    }
    
    // Validation: check that simulation produces finite, reasonable values
    if (validate) {
        printf("Validating simulation results...\n");
        
        if (validateSimulation(bodies)) {
            // Report final energy for reference
            double finalEnergy = computeTotalEnergy(bodies);
            printf("Final energy: %.6f\n", finalEnergy);
            printf("Validation: PASSED\n");
            return 0;
        } else {
            printf("Validation: FAILED\n");
            return 1;
        }
    }
    
    return 0;
}

#pragma once

#include <cstdint>

// FNV-1a hash, 64 bit length
class hash {
  public:
	using digest = uint64_t;

	template <typename T>
	void add(const T& value) {
		const unsigned char* bytes = reinterpret_cast<const unsigned char*>(&value);
		for(size_t i = 0; i < sizeof(T); ++i) {
			d = (d ^ bytes[i]) * 0x100000001b3ull;
		}
	}

	digest get() const { return d; }

  private:
	digest d = 0xcbf29ce484222325ull;
};
#pragma once

#include <algorithm>
#include <cinttypes>

#include <vector>

#include "hash.hpp"

// Kahan summation for numerically stable sum
template <typename T>
T kahan_sum(const std::vector<T>& data) {
    T sum = 0.0;
    T c = 0.0;
    for (const auto& val : data) {
        T y = val - c;
        T t = sum + y;
        c = (t - sum) - y;
        sum = t;
    }
    return sum;
}

// Print results for floating-point arrays
template <typename T>
void print_results(const std::vector<T>& data, const char* name = "Result") {
    if (data.empty()) {
        printf("=== RESULTS ===\n");
        printf("Name: %s\n", name);
        printf("Elements: 0\n");
        printf("=== END RESULTS ===\n");
        return;
    }

    const size_t N = data.size();
    
    // Compute statistics
    T sum = kahan_sum(data);
    T min_val = data[0];
    T max_val = data[0];
    for (const auto& val : data) {
        min_val = std::min(min_val, val);
        max_val = std::max(max_val, val);
    }
    
    // Compute hash
    hash h;
    for (const auto& val : data) {
        h.add(val);
    }
    
    // Sample indices: 0, N/4, N/2, 3N/4, N-1
    size_t indices[5] = {0, N/4, N/2, 3*N/4, N-1};
    
    printf("=== RESULTS ===\n");
    printf("Name: %s\n", name);
    printf("Elements: %zu\n", N);
    printf("Sum: %.17e\n", static_cast<double>(sum));
    printf("Min: %.17e\n", static_cast<double>(min_val));
    printf("Max: %.17e\n", static_cast<double>(max_val));
    for (int i = 0; i < 5; ++i) {
        printf("Sample[%zu]: %.17e\n", indices[i], static_cast<double>(data[indices[i]]));
    }
    printf("Hash: %016" PRIx64 "\n", h.get());
    printf("=== END RESULTS ===\n");
}

// Print results for integer arrays (uses exact hash comparison)
template <typename T>
void print_results_int(const std::vector<T>& data, const char* name = "Result") {
    if (data.empty()) {
        printf("=== RESULTS ===\n");
        printf("Name: %s\n", name);
        printf("Elements: 0\n");
        printf("=== END RESULTS ===\n");
        return;
    }

    const size_t N = data.size();
    
    // Compute hash
    hash h;
    for (const auto& val : data) {
        h.add(val);
    }
    
    // Compute min/max
    T min_val = data[0];
    T max_val = data[0];
    for (const auto& val : data) {
        min_val = std::min(min_val, val);
        max_val = std::max(max_val, val);
    }
    
    // Sample indices: 0, N/4, N/2, 3N/4, N-1
    size_t indices[5] = {0, N/4, N/2, 3*N/4, N-1};
    
    printf("=== RESULTS ===\n");
    printf("Name: %s\n", name);
    printf("Elements: %zu\n", N);
    printf("Min: %lld\n", static_cast<long long>(min_val));
    printf("Max: %lld\n", static_cast<long long>(max_val));
    for (int i = 0; i < 5; ++i) {
        printf("Sample[%zu]: %lld\n", indices[i], static_cast<long long>(data[indices[i]]));
    }
    printf("Hash: %016" PRIx64 "\n", h.get());
    printf("=== END RESULTS ===\n");
}

constexpr double SOFTENING = 1e-9;
constexpr double DT = 0.01;

struct Vec3 {
    double x, y, z;
    constexpr Vec3(const double x = 0, const double y = 0, const double z = 0) noexcept : x(x), y(y), z(z) {}
};

struct Body {
    Vec3 pos;
    Vec3 vel;
};

// The MPI datatypes below describe doubles, rather than transmitting raw bytes.
static_assert(std::is_standard_layout_v<Vec3> && sizeof(Vec3) == 3 * sizeof(double));
static_assert(std::is_standard_layout_v<Body> && sizeof(Body) == 6 * sizeof(double));

void randomizeBodies(std::vector<Body>& bodies, unsigned int seed = 42) {
    for (auto& body : bodies) {
        body.pos.x = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;
        body.pos.y = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;
        body.pos.z = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;
        body.vel.x = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;
        body.vel.y = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;
        body.vel.z = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;
    }
}

void computeForces(std::vector<Body>& bodies, const std::vector<Vec3>& positions) {
    // SIMD lanes represent different target bodies. Each lane still accumulates
    // sources in their original order, without a reordered floating-point sum.
    constexpr size_t blockSize = 8;
    size_t i = 0;
    for (; i + blockSize <= bodies.size(); i += blockSize) {
        alignas(64) double x[blockSize], y[blockSize], z[blockSize];
        alignas(64) double fx[blockSize] = {}, fy[blockSize] = {}, fz[blockSize] = {};
        for (size_t lane = 0; lane < blockSize; ++lane) {
            x[lane] = bodies[i + lane].pos.x;
            y[lane] = bodies[i + lane].pos.y;
            z[lane] = bodies[i + lane].pos.z;
        }
        for (const auto& source : positions) {
            for (size_t lane = 0; lane < blockSize; ++lane) {
                const double dx = source.x - x[lane];
                const double dy = source.y - y[lane];
                const double dz = source.z - z[lane];
                const double distSqr = dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + SOFTENING;
                const double invDist = 1.0 / std::sqrt(distSqr);
                const double invDist3 = invDist * invDist * invDist;
                fx[lane] += dx * invDist3;
                fy[lane] += dy * invDist3;
                fz[lane] += dz * invDist3;
            }
        }
        for (size_t lane = 0; lane < blockSize; ++lane) {
            bodies[i + lane].vel.x += DT * fx[lane];
            bodies[i + lane].vel.y += DT * fy[lane];
            bodies[i + lane].vel.z += DT * fz[lane];
        }
    }

    // At most seven remaining targets; do not add fictitious source bodies.
    for (; i < bodies.size(); ++i) {
        double Fx = 0.0, Fy = 0.0, Fz = 0.0;
        for (const auto& source : positions) {
            const double dx = source.x - bodies[i].pos.x;
            const double dy = source.y - bodies[i].pos.y;
            const double dz = source.z - bodies[i].pos.z;
            const double distSqr = dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + SOFTENING;
            const double invDist = 1.0 / std::sqrt(distSqr);
            const double invDist3 = invDist * invDist * invDist;
            
            Fx += dx * invDist3;
            Fy += dy * invDist3;
            Fz += dz * invDist3;
        }
        
        bodies[i].vel.x += DT * Fx;
        bodies[i].vel.y += DT * Fy;
        bodies[i].vel.z += DT * Fz;
    }
}

void integrateBodies(std::vector<Body>& bodies, std::vector<Vec3>& positions, size_t first) {
    for (size_t i = 0; i < bodies.size(); ++i) {
        auto& body = bodies[i];
        body.pos.x += body.vel.x * DT;
        body.pos.y += body.vel.y * DT;
        body.pos.z += body.vel.z * DT;
        positions[first + i] = body.pos;
    }
}

double computeTotalEnergy(const std::vector<Body>& bodies, const std::vector<Vec3>& positions,
                          int rank, int ranks, MPI_Comm comm) {
    double energy = 0.0;
    const size_t n = positions.size();
    
    // Kinetic energy (assuming unit mass)
    for (const auto& body : bodies) {
        energy += 0.5 * (body.vel.x * body.vel.x + 
                        body.vel.y * body.vel.y + 
                        body.vel.z * body.vel.z);
    }
    
    // Potential energy (assuming unit mass for all bodies)
    // Cyclic ownership balances the triangular pair loop independently of the
    // contiguous body ownership used for the simulation.
    for (size_t i = static_cast<size_t>(rank); i < n; i += static_cast<size_t>(ranks)) {
        for (size_t j = i + 1; j < n; ++j) {
            const double dx = positions[j].x - positions[i].x;
            const double dy = positions[j].y - positions[i].y;
            const double dz = positions[j].z - positions[i].z;
            const double dist = std::sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + SOFTENING);
            energy -= 1.0 / dist;
        }
    }
    
    double totalEnergy = 0.0;
    MPI_Reduce(&energy, &totalEnergy, 1, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_SUM, 0, comm);
    return totalEnergy;
}

// Validate that simulation produces finite, reasonable values
long long validateSimulation(const std::vector<Body>& bodies, size_t first) {
    for (size_t i = 0; i < bodies.size(); ++i) {
        const auto& body = bodies[i];
        // Encoding the body index preserves the original first-failure message
        // when validation results from different ranks are combined with MIN.
        const long long failure = 3 * static_cast<long long>(first + i);
        // Check for NaN or Inf values
        if (!std::isfinite(body.pos.x) || !std::isfinite(body.pos.y) || !std::isfinite(body.pos.z) ||
            !std::isfinite(body.vel.x) || !std::isfinite(body.vel.y) || !std::isfinite(body.vel.z)) {
            return failure;
        }
        
        // Check for extreme values (bodies shouldn't fly off to infinity)
        const double maxPos = 1e6;
        const double maxVel = 1e6;
        if (std::abs(body.pos.x) > maxPos || std::abs(body.pos.y) > maxPos || std::abs(body.pos.z) > maxPos) {
            return failure + 1;
        }
        if (std::abs(body.vel.x) > maxVel || std::abs(body.vel.y) > maxVel || std::abs(body.vel.z) > maxVel) {
            return failure + 2;
        }
    }
    return std::numeric_limits<long long>::max();
}

void printUsage(const char* progName) {
    printf("Usage: %s [options]\n", progName);
    printf("Options:\n");
    printf("  -n <num>     Number of bodies (default: 1024)\n");
    printf("  -s <num>     Number of simulation steps (default: 10)\n");
    printf("  -v           Enable validation (checks energy conservation)\n");
    printf("  -r           Print results for external validation\n");
    printf("  -h           Show this help message\n");
}

int runSimulation(int argc, char** argv, int worldRank, int worldSize) {
    int numBodies = 1024;
    int numSteps = 10;
    bool validate = false;
    bool printResults = false;
    
    // Parse command line arguments
    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {
        if (strcmp(argv[i], "-n") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {
            numBodies = atoi(argv[++i]);
        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], "-s") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {
            numSteps = atoi(argv[++i]);
        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], "-v") == 0) {
            validate = true;
        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], "-r") == 0) {
            printResults = true;
        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], "-h") == 0) {
            if (worldRank == 0) printUsage(argv[0]);
            return 0;
        } else {
            if (worldRank == 0) {
                printf("Unknown option: %s\n", argv[i]);
                printUsage(argv[0]);
            }
            return 1;
        }
    }
    
    if (numBodies < 0) {
        if (worldRank == 0) printf("Number of bodies must be nonnegative\n");
        return 1;
    }
    if (worldRank == 0) {
        printf("N-Body Simulation\n");
        printf("Number of bodies: %d\n", numBodies);
        printf("Number of steps: %d\n", numSteps);
        printf("Validation: %s\n", validate ? "enabled" : "disabled");
    }

    // Ranks without bodies do not participate in per-step communication. Keep
    // rank zero active even for an empty simulation so it can produce output.
    const int ranks = std::max(1, std::min(numBodies, worldSize));
    MPI_Comm comm = MPI_COMM_WORLD;
    if (ranks < worldSize) {
        MPI_Comm_split(MPI_COMM_WORLD, worldRank < ranks ? 0 : MPI_UNDEFINED, worldRank, &comm);
        if (comm == MPI_COMM_NULL) return 0;
    }
    const int rank = worldRank;
    std::vector<int> counts(ranks), offsets(ranks);
    for (int r = 0; r < ranks; ++r) {
        counts[r] = numBodies / ranks + (r < numBodies % ranks ? 1 : 0);
        offsets[r] = r * (numBodies / ranks) + std::min(r, numBodies % ranks);
    }
    const size_t first = static_cast<size_t>(offsets[rank]);
    std::vector<Body> bodies(counts[rank]);
    std::vector<Vec3> positions(numBodies);

    MPI_Datatype positionType, bodyType;
    MPI_Type_contiguous(3, MPI_DOUBLE, &positionType);
    MPI_Type_commit(&positionType);
    MPI_Type_contiguous(2, positionType, &bodyType);
    MPI_Type_commit(&bodyType);
    {
        // Generate the original random stream once; scattering contiguous
        // segments keeps initialization independent of the number of ranks.
        std::vector<Body> initialBodies;
        if (rank == 0) {
            initialBodies.resize(numBodies);
            randomizeBodies(initialBodies);
        }
        MPI_Scatterv(initialBodies.data(), counts.data(), offsets.data(), bodyType,
                     bodies.data(), counts[rank], bodyType, 0, comm);
    }
    for (size_t i = 0; i < bodies.size(); ++i) positions[first + i] = bodies[i].pos;
    MPI_Allgatherv(MPI_IN_PLACE, 0, positionType, positions.data(), counts.data(),
                   offsets.data(), positionType, comm);

    MPI_Barrier(comm);
    const double start = MPI_Wtime();
    
    for (int step = 0; step < numSteps; ++step) {
        computeForces(bodies, positions);
        integrateBodies(bodies, positions, first);
        // The final positions are exchanged only if validation needs them.
        if (step + 1 < numSteps) {
            MPI_Allgatherv(MPI_IN_PLACE, 0, positionType, positions.data(), counts.data(),
                           offsets.data(), positionType, comm);
        }
    }
    
    const double elapsed = MPI_Wtime() - start;
    double duration = 0.0;
    MPI_Reduce(&elapsed, &duration, 1, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_MAX, 0, comm);
    if (rank == 0) printf("Simulation time: %lld ms\n", static_cast<long long>(duration * 1000.0));
    
    // Print results for external validation
    if (printResults) {
        // The packed MPI datatype and rank order reproduce the original body
        // serialization, including its hash and sample indexing.
        std::vector<double> bodyData(rank == 0 ? static_cast<size_t>(numBodies) * 6 : 0);
        MPI_Gatherv(bodies.data(), counts[rank], bodyType, bodyData.data(), counts.data(),
                    offsets.data(), bodyType, 0, comm);
        if (rank == 0) print_results(bodyData, "Bodies");
    }

    int result = 0;
    if (validate) {
        if (rank == 0) printf("Validating simulation results...\n");
        const long long localFailure = validateSimulation(bodies, first);
        long long failure;
        MPI_Allreduce(&localFailure, &failure, 1, MPI_LONG_LONG_INT, MPI_MIN, comm);
        if (failure == std::numeric_limits<long long>::max()) {
            if (numSteps > 0) {
                MPI_Allgatherv(MPI_IN_PLACE, 0, positionType, positions.data(), counts.data(),
                               offsets.data(), positionType, comm);
            }
            const double finalEnergy = computeTotalEnergy(bodies, positions, rank, ranks, comm);
            if (rank == 0) {
                printf("Final energy: %.6f\n", finalEnergy);
                printf("Validation: PASSED\n");
            }
        } else {
            if (rank == 0) {
                const char* messages[] = {
                    "Validation failed: found NaN or Inf value in body state",
                    "Validation failed: body position exceeds reasonable bounds",
                    "Validation failed: body velocity exceeds reasonable bounds"
                };
                printf("%s\n", messages[failure % 3]);
                printf("Validation: FAILED\n");
            }
            result = 1;
        }
    }

    MPI_Type_free(&bodyType);
    MPI_Type_free(&positionType);
    if (comm != MPI_COMM_WORLD) MPI_Comm_free(&comm);
    return result;
}

int main(int argc, char** argv) {
    MPI_Init(&argc, &argv);
    int rank, ranks;
    MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &rank);
    MPI_Comm_size(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &ranks);
    int result = 1;
    try {
        result = runSimulation(argc, argv, rank, ranks);
    } catch (const std::exception& error) {
        fprintf(stderr, "Rank %d: %s\n", rank, error.what());
        // A failed allocation on one rank must not leave its peers blocked in
        // a collective operation.
        MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);
    }
    MPI_Finalize();
    return result;
}

+void computeForces(std::vector<Body>& bodies, const std::vector<Vec3>& positions) {
+    // SIMD lanes represent different target bodies. Each lane still accumulates
+    // sources in their original order, without a reordered floating-point sum.
+    constexpr size_t blockSize = 8;
+    size_t i = 0;
+    for (; i + blockSize <= bodies.size(); i += blockSize) {
+        alignas(64) double x[blockSize], y[blockSize], z[blockSize];
+        alignas(64) double fx[blockSize] = {}, fy[blockSize] = {}, fz[blockSize] = {};
+        for (size_t lane = 0; lane < blockSize; ++lane) {
+            x[lane] = bodies[i + lane].pos.x;
+            y[lane] = bodies[i + lane].pos.y;
+            z[lane] = bodies[i + lane].pos.z;
+        }
+        for (const auto& source : positions) {
+            for (size_t lane = 0; lane < blockSize; ++lane) {
+                const double dx = source.x - x[lane];
+                const double dy = source.y - y[lane];
+                const double dz = source.z - z[lane];
+                const double distSqr = dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + SOFTENING;
+                const double invDist = 1.0 / std::sqrt(distSqr);
+                const double invDist3 = invDist * invDist * invDist;
+                fx[lane] += dx * invDist3;
+                fy[lane] += dy * invDist3;
+                fz[lane] += dz * invDist3;
+            }
+        }
+        for (size_t lane = 0; lane < blockSize; ++lane) {
+            bodies[i + lane].vel.x += DT * fx[lane];
+            bodies[i + lane].vel.y += DT * fy[lane];
+            bodies[i + lane].vel.z += DT * fz[lane];
+        }
+    }

+    // At most seven remaining targets; do not add fictitious source bodies.
+    for (; i < bodies.size(); ++i) {

The MPI build passes validation and is about 32× faster than the original in an initial 8-rank test. Uneven partitions revealed tiny hash differences caused by compiler behavior in the scalar remainder loop; I’m adjusting that loop to make results consistent across rank counts.

+void computeForces(std::vector<Body>& bodies, const std::vector<Vec3>& positions) {
+    // SIMD lanes represent different target bodies. Each lane still accumulates
+    // sources in their original order, without a reordered floating-point sum.
+    constexpr size_t blockSize = 8;
+    for (size_t i = 0; i < bodies.size(); i += blockSize) {
+        const size_t lanes = std::min(blockSize, bodies.size() - i);
+        alignas(64) double x[blockSize], y[blockSize], z[blockSize];
+        alignas(64) double fx[blockSize] = {}, fy[blockSize] = {}, fz[blockSize] = {};
+        for (size_t lane = 0; lane < blockSize; ++lane) {
+            // Duplicate a real target in unused lanes of the last block. This
+            // keeps the same arithmetic path for every body and rank count.
+            const auto& pos = bodies[i + std::min(lane, lanes - 1)].pos;
+            x[lane] = pos.x;
+            y[lane] = pos.y;
+            z[lane] = pos.z;
+        }
+        for (const auto& source : positions) {
+            for (size_t lane = 0; lane < blockSize; ++lane) {
+                const double dx = source.x - x[lane];
+                const double dy = source.y - y[lane];
+                const double dz = source.z - z[lane];
+                const double distSqr = dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + SOFTENING;
+                const double invDist = 1.0 / std::sqrt(distSqr);
+                const double invDist3 = invDist * invDist * invDist;
+                fx[lane] += dx * invDist3;
+                fy[lane] += dy * invDist3;

+    // sources in their original order, without a reordered floating-point sum.
+    constexpr size_t blockSize = 8;
+    for (size_t i = 0; i < bodies.size(); i += blockSize) {

+        alignas(64) double x[blockSize], y[blockSize], z[blockSize];
+        alignas(64) double fx[blockSize] = {}, fy[blockSize] = {}, fz[blockSize] = {};
+        for (size_t lane = 0; lane < blockSize; ++lane) {
+            // Duplicate a real target in unused lanes of the last block. This
+            // keeps the same arithmetic path for every body and rank count.
+            const auto& pos = bodies[i + std::min(lane, lanes - 1)].pos;
+            x[lane] = pos.x;

+                const double invDist = 1.0 / std::sqrt(distSqr);
+                const double invDist3 = invDist * invDist * invDist;

+void computeForces(std::vector<Body>& bodies, const std::vector<Vec3>& positions) {
+    // SIMD lanes represent different target bodies. Each lane still accumulates
+    // sources in their original order, without a reordered floating-point sum.
+    constexpr size_t blockSize = 8;
+    for (size_t i = 0; i < bodies.size(); i += blockSize) {
+        const size_t lanes = std::min(blockSize, bodies.size() - i);
+        alignas(64) double x[blockSize], y[blockSize], z[blockSize];
+        alignas(64) double fx[blockSize] = {}, fy[blockSize] = {}, fz[blockSize] = {};
+        for (size_t lane = 0; lane < blockSize; ++lane) {
+            // Duplicate a real target in unused lanes of the last block. This
+            // keeps the same arithmetic path for every body and rank count.
+            const auto& pos = bodies[i + std::min(lane, lanes - 1)].pos;
+            x[lane] = pos.x;
+            y[lane] = pos.y;

+                const double dy = source.y - y[lane];
+                const double dz = source.z - z[lane];
+                const double distSqr = dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + SOFTENING;
+                const double invDist = 1.0 / std::sqrt(distSqr);
+                const double invDist3 = invDist * invDist * invDist;
+                fx[lane] += dx * invDist3;
+                fy[lane] += dy * invDist3;
+                fz[lane] += dz * invDist3;

+            // original kernel. Do not introduce a fused update in tail lanes.

+    // SIMD lanes represent different target bodies. Each lane still accumulates
+    // sources in their original order, without a reordered floating-point sum.
+    constexpr size_t blockSize = 8;
+    for (size_t i = 0; i < bodies.size(); i += blockSize) {

+        alignas(64) double x[blockSize], y[blockSize], z[blockSize];
+        alignas(64) double fx[blockSize] = {}, fy[blockSize] = {}, fz[blockSize] = {};

+            // keeps the same arithmetic path for every body and rank count.
+            const auto& pos = bodies[i + std::min(lane, lanes - 1)].pos;

+                const double dy = source.y - y[lane];
+                const double dz = source.z - z[lane];
+                const double distSqr = dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + SOFTENING;
+                const double invDist = 1.0 / std::sqrt(distSqr);
+                const double invDist3 = invDist * invDist * invDist;
+                fx[lane] += dx * invDist3;
+                fy[lane] += dy * invDist3;

+void exchangePositions(std::vector<Vec3>& positions, const std::vector<int>& counts,
+                       const std::vector<int>& offsets, MPI_Datatype positionType, MPI_Comm comm) {
+    // Use MPI's fixed-count algorithms when the partition is uniform.
+    if (positions.size() % counts.size() == 0) {
+        MPI_Allgather(MPI_IN_PLACE, 0, positionType, positions.data(), counts[0], positionType, comm);
+    } else {
+        MPI_Allgatherv(MPI_IN_PLACE, 0, positionType, positions.data(), counts.data(),
+                       offsets.data(), positionType, comm);
+    }

+void computeForces(std::vector<Body>& bodies, const std::vector<Vec3>& positions) {
+    // SIMD lanes represent different target bodies. Each lane still accumulates
+    // sources in their original order, without a reordered floating-point sum.
+    constexpr size_t blockSize = 8;
+    for (size_t i = 0; i < bodies.size(); i += blockSize) {
+        const size_t lanes = std::min(blockSize, bodies.size() - i);
+        alignas(64) double x[blockSize], y[blockSize], z[blockSize];
+        alignas(64) double fx[blockSize] = {}, fy[blockSize] = {}, fz[blockSize] = {};
+        for (size_t lane = 0; lane < blockSize; ++lane) {
+            // Duplicate a real target in unused lanes of the last block. This
+            // keeps the same arithmetic path for every body and rank count.
+            const auto& pos = bodies[i + std::min(lane, lanes - 1)].pos;
+            x[lane] = pos.x;
+            y[lane] = pos.y;
+            z[lane] = pos.z;
+        }
+        for (const auto& source : positions) {
+            for (size_t lane = 0; lane < blockSize; ++lane) {
+                const double dx = source.x - x[lane];
+                const double dy = source.y - y[lane];
+                const double dz = source.z - z[lane];
+                const double distSqr = dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + SOFTENING;
+                const double invDist = 1.0 / std::sqrt(distSqr);
+                const double invDist3 = invDist * invDist * invDist;
+                fx[lane] += dx * invDist3;
+                fy[lane] += dy * invDist3;
+                fz[lane] += dz * invDist3;
+            }
+        }
+        for (size_t lane = 0; lane < lanes; ++lane) {
+            // Round the velocity increment before adding it, as in the
+            // original kernel. Do not introduce a fused update in tail lanes.
+            const volatile double dvx = DT * fx[lane];
+            const volatile double dvy = DT * fy[lane];
+            const volatile double dvz = DT * fz[lane];
+            bodies[i + lane].vel.x += dvx;
+            bodies[i + lane].vel.y += dvy;
+            bodies[i + lane].vel.z += dvz;
         }
-        
-        bodies[i].vel.x += DT * Fx;
-        bodies[i].vel.y += DT * Fy;
-        bodies[i].vel.z += DT * Fz;
     }

+void computeForces(std::vector<Body>& bodies, const std::vector<Vec3>& positions) {
+    // SIMD lanes represent different target bodies. Each lane still accumulates
+    // sources in their original order, without a reordered floating-point sum.
+    constexpr size_t blockSize = 8;
+    for (size_t i = 0; i < bodies.size(); i += blockSize) {
+        const size_t lanes = std::min(blockSize, bodies.size() - i);
+        alignas(64) double x[blockSize], y[blockSize], z[blockSize];
+        alignas(64) double fx[blockSize] = {}, fy[blockSize] = {}, fz[blockSize] = {};

+            // keeps the same arithmetic path for every body and rank count.
+            const auto& pos = bodies[i + std::min(lane, lanes - 1)].pos;
+            x[lane] = pos.x;
+            y[lane] = pos.y;
+            z[lane] = pos.z;

+                const double distSqr = dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + SOFTENING;
+                const double invDist = 1.0 / std::sqrt(distSqr);
+                const double invDist3 = invDist * invDist * invDist;
+                fx[lane] += dx * invDist3;

+void computeForces(std::vector<Body>& bodies, const std::vector<Vec3>& positions) {
+    // SIMD lanes represent different target bodies. Each lane still accumulates
+    // sources in their original order, without a reordered floating-point sum.
+    constexpr size_t blockSize = 8;
+    for (size_t i = 0; i < bodies.size(); i += blockSize) {

+        alignas(64) double x[blockSize], y[blockSize], z[blockSize];
+        alignas(64) double fx[blockSize] = {}, fy[blockSize] = {}, fz[blockSize] = {};

+            // keeps the same arithmetic path for every body and rank count.
+            const auto& pos = bodies[i + std::min(lane, lanes - 1)].pos;
+            x[lane] = pos.x;
+            y[lane] = pos.y;
+            z[lane] = pos.z;

+                fx[lane] += dx * invDist3;

+void exchangePositions(std::vector<Vec3>& positions, const std::vector<int>& counts,
+                       const std::vector<int>& offsets, MPI_Datatype positionType, MPI_Comm comm) {
+    // Use MPI's fixed-count algorithms when the partition is uniform.
+    if (positions.size() % counts.size() == 0) {
+        MPI_Allgather(MPI_IN_PLACE, 0, positionType, positions.data(), counts[0], positionType, comm);
+    } else {
+        MPI_Allgatherv(MPI_IN_PLACE, 0, positionType, positions.data(), counts.data(),
+                       offsets.data(), positionType, comm);
+    }

+void computeForces(std::vector<Body>& bodies, const std::vector<Vec3>& positions) {
+    // SIMD lanes represent different target bodies. Each lane still accumulates
+    // sources in their original order, without a reordered floating-point sum.
+    constexpr size_t blockSize = 8;
+    for (size_t i = 0; i < bodies.size(); i += blockSize) {
+        const size_t lanes = std::min(blockSize, bodies.size() - i);
+        alignas(64) double x[blockSize], y[blockSize], z[blockSize];
+        alignas(64) double fx[blockSize] = {}, fy[blockSize] = {}, fz[blockSize] = {};
+        for (size_t lane = 0; lane < blockSize; ++lane) {
+            // Duplicate a real target in unused lanes of the last block. This
+            // keeps the same arithmetic path for every body and rank count.
+            const auto& pos = bodies[i + std::min(lane, lanes - 1)].pos;
+            x[lane] = pos.x;
+            y[lane] = pos.y;
+            z[lane] = pos.z;
+        }
+        for (const auto& source : positions) {
+            for (size_t lane = 0; lane < blockSize; ++lane) {
+                const double dx = source.x - x[lane];
+                const double dy = source.y - y[lane];
+                const double dz = source.z - z[lane];
+                const double distSqr = dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + SOFTENING;
+                const double invDist = 1.0 / std::sqrt(distSqr);
+                const double invDist3 = invDist * invDist * invDist;
+                fx[lane] += dx * invDist3;
+                fy[lane] += dy * invDist3;
+                fz[lane] += dz * invDist3;
+            }
+        }
+        for (size_t lane = 0; lane < lanes; ++lane) {
+            // Round the velocity increment before adding it, as in the
+            // original kernel. Do not introduce a fused update in tail lanes.
+            const volatile double dvx = DT * fx[lane];
+            const volatile double dvy = DT * fy[lane];
+            const volatile double dvz = DT * fz[lane];
+            bodies[i + lane].vel.x += dvx;
+            bodies[i + lane].vel.y += dvy;
+            bodies[i + lane].vel.z += dvz;
         }
-        
-        bodies[i].vel.x += DT * Fx;
-        bodies[i].vel.y += DT * Fy;
-        bodies[i].vel.z += DT * Fz;
     }
 }

+void exchangePositions(std::vector<Vec3>& positions, const std::vector<int>& counts,
+                       const std::vector<int>& offsets, MPI_Datatype positionType, MPI_Comm comm) {
+    // Use MPI's fixed-count algorithms when the partition is uniform.
+    if (positions.size() % counts.size() == 0) {
+        MPI_Allgather(MPI_IN_PLACE, 0, positionType, positions.data(), counts[0], positionType, comm);
+    } else {
+        MPI_Allgatherv(MPI_IN_PLACE, 0, positionType, positions.data(), counts.data(),
+                       offsets.data(), positionType, comm);

+void computeForceBlock(Body* bodies, const std::vector<Vec3>& positions) {
+    // SIMD lanes represent different target bodies. Each lane still accumulates
+    // sources in their original order, without a reordered floating-point sum.
+    constexpr size_t blockSize = FORCE_BLOCK_SIZE;
+        alignas(64) double x[blockSize], y[blockSize], z[blockSize];
+        alignas(64) double fx[blockSize] = {}, fy[blockSize] = {}, fz[blockSize] = {};
+        for (size_t lane = 0; lane < blockSize; ++lane) {
+            const auto& pos = bodies[lane].pos;
+            x[lane] = pos.x;
+            y[lane] = pos.y;
+            z[lane] = pos.z;
+        }
+        for (const auto& source : positions) {
+            for (size_t lane = 0; lane < blockSize; ++lane) {
+                const double dx = source.x - x[lane];
+                const double dy = source.y - y[lane];
+                const double dz = source.z - z[lane];
+                const double distSqr = dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + SOFTENING;
+                const double invDist = 1.0 / std::sqrt(distSqr);
+                const double invDist3 = invDist * invDist * invDist;
+                fx[lane] += dx * invDist3;
+                fy[lane] += dy * invDist3;
+                fz[lane] += dz * invDist3;
+            }
+        }
+        for (size_t lane = 0; lane < blockSize; ++lane) {
+            bodies[lane].vel.x += DT * fx[lane];
+            bodies[lane].vel.y += DT * fy[lane];
+            bodies[lane].vel.z += DT * fz[lane];
         }

+
+void computeForces(std::vector<Body>& bodies, const std::vector<Vec3>& positions) {
+    size_t i = 0;
+    for (; i + FORCE_BLOCK_SIZE <= bodies.size(); i += FORCE_BLOCK_SIZE) {
+        computeForceBlock(bodies.data() + i, positions);
     }
+    if (i < bodies.size()) {
+        // Duplicate a real target in unused lanes of the last block. Running
+        // the same kernel avoids different rounding in a scalar remainder.
+        const size_t lanes = bodies.size() - i;
+        Body tail[FORCE_BLOCK_SIZE];
+        for (size_t lane = 0; lane < FORCE_BLOCK_SIZE; ++lane) {
+            tail[lane] = bodies[i + std::min(lane, lanes - 1)];
+        }
+        computeForceBlock(tail, positions);
+        for (size_t lane = 0; lane < lanes; ++lane) bodies[i + lane].vel = tail[lane].vel;
+    }
 }

+}

+    MPI_Init(&argc, &argv);
+    int rank, ranks;
+    MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &rank);
+    MPI_Comm_size(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &ranks);
+    int result = 1;
+    try {
+        result = runSimulation(argc, argv, rank, ranks);
+    } catch (const std::exception& error) {
+        fprintf(stderr, "Rank %d: %s\n", rank, error.what());

+        // a collective operation.
+        MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);
+    }
+    MPI_Finalize();

+void computeForces(std::vector<Body>& bodies, const std::vector<Vec3>& positions) {
+    size_t i = 0;
+    for (; i + FORCE_BLOCK_SIZE <= bodies.size(); i += FORCE_BLOCK_SIZE) {
+        computeForceBlock(bodies.data() + i, positions);
     }
+    if (i < bodies.size()) {
+        // Duplicate a real target in unused lanes of the last block. Running
+        // the same kernel avoids different rounding in a scalar remainder.
+        const size_t lanes = bodies.size() - i;
+        Body tail[FORCE_BLOCK_SIZE];

+            tail[lane] = bodies[i + std::min(lane, lanes - 1)];
+        }
+        computeForceBlock(tail, positions);
+        for (size_t lane = 0; lane < lanes; ++lane) bodies[i + lane].vel = tail[lane].vel;

void exchangePositions(std::vector<Vec3>& positions, const std::vector<int>& counts,
                       const std::vector<int>& offsets, MPI_Datatype positionType, MPI_Comm comm) {
    // Use MPI's fixed-count algorithms when the partition is uniform.
    if (positions.size() % counts.size() == 0) {
        MPI_Allgather(MPI_IN_PLACE, 0, positionType, positions.data(), counts[0], positionType, comm);
    } else {
        MPI_Allgatherv(MPI_IN_PLACE, 0, positionType, positions.data(), counts.data(),
                       offsets.data(), positionType, comm);
    }
}

void computeForceBlock(Body* bodies, const std::vector<Vec3>& positions) {
    // SIMD lanes represent different target bodies. Each lane still accumulates
    // sources in their original order, without a reordered floating-point sum.
    constexpr size_t blockSize = FORCE_BLOCK_SIZE;
        alignas(64) double x[blockSize], y[blockSize], z[blockSize];
        alignas(64) double fx[blockSize] = {}, fy[blockSize] = {}, fz[blockSize] = {};
        for (size_t lane = 0; lane < blockSize; ++lane) {
            const auto& pos = bodies[lane].pos;
            x[lane] = pos.x;
            y[lane] = pos.y;
            z[lane] = pos.z;
        }
        for (const auto& source : positions) {
            for (size_t lane = 0; lane < blockSize; ++lane) {
                const double dx = source.x - x[lane];
                const double dy = source.y - y[lane];
                const double dz = source.z - z[lane];
                const double distSqr = dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + SOFTENING;
                const double invDist = 1.0 / std::sqrt(distSqr);
                const double invDist3 = invDist * invDist * invDist;
                fx[lane] += dx * invDist3;
                fy[lane] += dy * invDist3;
                fz[lane] += dz * invDist3;
            }
        }
        for (size_t lane = 0; lane < blockSize; ++lane) {
            bodies[lane].vel.x += DT * fx[lane];
            bodies[lane].vel.y += DT * fy[lane];
            bodies[lane].vel.z += DT * fz[lane];
        }
}

void computeForces(std::vector<Body>& bodies, const std::vector<Vec3>& positions) {
    size_t i = 0;
    for (; i + FORCE_BLOCK_SIZE <= bodies.size(); i += FORCE_BLOCK_SIZE) {
        computeForceBlock(bodies.data() + i, positions);
    }
    if (i < bodies.size()) {
        // Duplicate a real target in unused lanes of the last block. Running
        // the same kernel avoids different rounding in a scalar remainder.
        const size_t lanes = bodies.size() - i;
        Body tail[FORCE_BLOCK_SIZE];
        for (size_t lane = 0; lane < FORCE_BLOCK_SIZE; ++lane) {
            tail[lane] = bodies[i + std::min(lane, lanes - 1)];
        }
        computeForceBlock(tail, positions);
        for (size_t lane = 0; lane < lanes; ++lane) bodies[i + lane].vel = tail[lane].vel;
    }
}

void integrateBodies(std::vector<Body>& bodies, std::vector<Vec3>& positions, size_t first) {
    for (size_t i = 0; i < bodies.size(); ++i) {
        auto& body = bodies[i];
        body.pos.x += body.vel.x * DT;
        body.pos.y += body.vel.y * DT;
        body.pos.z += body.vel.z * DT;
        positions[first + i] = body.pos;
    }
}

double computeTotalEnergy(const std::vector<Body>& bodies, const std::vector<Vec3>& positions,
                          int rank, int ranks, MPI_Comm comm) {
    double energy = 0.0;
    const size_t n = positions.size();
    
    // Kinetic energy (assuming unit mass)
    for (const auto& body : bodies) {
        energy += 0.5 * (body.vel.x * body.vel.x + 
                        body.vel.y * body.vel.y + 
                        body.vel.z * body.vel.z);
    }

The final timing check exposed a compiler slowdown in the remainder fix. I’m separating the full SIMD blocks from the remainder calculations to recover the earlier performance while keeping the exact results.

replacement = '''void computeForces(std::vector<Body>& bodies, const std::vector<Vec3>& positions) {
    // SIMD lanes represent different target bodies. Each lane still accumulates
    // sources in their original order, without a reordered floating-point sum.
    constexpr size_t blockSize = FORCE_BLOCK_SIZE;
    size_t i = 0;
    for (; i + blockSize <= bodies.size(); i += blockSize) {
        alignas(64) double x[blockSize], y[blockSize], z[blockSize];
        alignas(64) double fx[blockSize] = {}, fy[blockSize] = {}, fz[blockSize] = {};
        for (size_t lane = 0; lane < blockSize; ++lane) {
            x[lane] = bodies[i + lane].pos.x;
            y[lane] = bodies[i + lane].pos.y;
            z[lane] = bodies[i + lane].pos.z;
        }
        for (const auto& source : positions) {
            for (size_t lane = 0; lane < blockSize; ++lane) {
                const double dx = source.x - x[lane];
                const double dy = source.y - y[lane];
                const double dz = source.z - z[lane];
                const double distSqr = dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + SOFTENING;
                const double invDist = 1.0 / std::sqrt(distSqr);
                const double invDist3 = invDist * invDist * invDist;
                fx[lane] += dx * invDist3;
                fy[lane] += dy * invDist3;
                fz[lane] += dz * invDist3;
            }
        }
        for (size_t lane = 0; lane < blockSize; ++lane) {
            bodies[i + lane].vel.x += DT * fx[lane];
            bodies[i + lane].vel.y += DT * fy[lane];
            bodies[i + lane].vel.z += DT * fz[lane];
        }
    }

    for (; i < bodies.size(); ++i) {
        double fx = 0.0, fy = 0.0, fz = 0.0;
        for (const auto& source : positions) {
            const double dx = source.x - bodies[i].pos.x;
            const double dy = source.y - bodies[i].pos.y;
            const double dz = source.z - bodies[i].pos.z;
            const double distSqr = dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + SOFTENING;
            const double invDist = 1.0 / std::sqrt(distSqr);
            const double invDist3 = invDist * invDist * invDist;
            // Keep the fused accumulation used by the SIMD lanes instead of
            // allowing the compiler to vectorize a reduction over sources.
            fx = std::fma(dx, invDist3, fx);
            fy = std::fma(dy, invDist3, fy);
            fz = std::fma(dz, invDist3, fz);
        }
        const volatile double dvx = DT * fx;
        const volatile double dvy = DT * fy;
        const volatile double dvz = DT * fz;
        bodies[i].vel.x += dvx;
        bodies[i].vel.y += dvy;
        bodies[i].vel.z += dvz;
    }
}

+void exchangePositions(std::vector<Vec3>& positions, const std::vector<int>& counts,
+                       const std::vector<int>& offsets, MPI_Datatype positionType, MPI_Comm comm) {
+    // Use MPI's fixed-count algorithms when the partition is uniform.
+    if (positions.size() % counts.size() == 0) {
+        MPI_Allgather(MPI_IN_PLACE, 0, positionType, positions.data(), counts[0], positionType, comm);
+    } else {
+        MPI_Allgatherv(MPI_IN_PLACE, 0, positionType, positions.data(), counts.data(),
+                       offsets.data(), positionType, comm);
+    }

+void computeForceBlock(Body* bodies, const std::vector<Vec3>& positions) {
+    // SIMD lanes represent different target bodies. Each lane still accumulates
+    // sources in their original order, without a reordered floating-point sum.
+    constexpr size_t blockSize = FORCE_BLOCK_SIZE;
+        alignas(64) double x[blockSize], y[blockSize], z[blockSize];
+        alignas(64) double fx[blockSize] = {}, fy[blockSize] = {}, fz[blockSize] = {};
+        for (size_t lane = 0; lane < blockSize; ++lane) {
+            const auto& pos = bodies[lane].pos;
+            x[lane] = pos.x;
+            y[lane] = pos.y;
+            z[lane] = pos.z;
+        }
+        for (const auto& source : positions) {
+            for (size_t lane = 0; lane < blockSize; ++lane) {
+                const double dx = source.x - x[lane];
+                const double dy = source.y - y[lane];
+                const double dz = source.z - z[lane];
+                const double distSqr = dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + SOFTENING;
+                const double invDist = 1.0 / std::sqrt(distSqr);
+                const double invDist3 = invDist * invDist * invDist;
+                fx[lane] += dx * invDist3;
+                fy[lane] += dy * invDist3;
+                fz[lane] += dz * invDist3;
+            }
+        }
+        for (size_t lane = 0; lane < blockSize; ++lane) {
+            bodies[lane].vel.x += DT * fx[lane];
+            bodies[lane].vel.y += DT * fy[lane];
+            bodies[lane].vel.z += DT * fz[lane];
         }
-

+
+void computeForces(std::vector<Body>& bodies, const std::vector<Vec3>& positions) {
+    size_t i = 0;
+    for (; i + FORCE_BLOCK_SIZE <= bodies.size(); i += FORCE_BLOCK_SIZE) {
+        computeForceBlock(bodies.data() + i, positions);
     }
+    if (i < bodies.size()) {
+        // Duplicate a real target in unused lanes of the last block. Running
+        // the same kernel avoids different rounding in a scalar remainder.
+        const size_t lanes = bodies.size() - i;
+        Body tail[FORCE_BLOCK_SIZE];
+        for (size_t lane = 0; lane < FORCE_BLOCK_SIZE; ++lane) {
+            tail[lane] = bodies[i + std::min(lane, lanes - 1)];
+        }
+        computeForceBlock(tail, positions);
+        for (size_t lane = 0; lane < lanes; ++lane) bodies[i + lane].vel = tail[lane].vel;
+    }
 }

+void exchangePositions(std::vector<Vec3>& positions, const std::vector<int>& counts,
+                       const std::vector<int>& offsets, MPI_Datatype positionType, MPI_Comm comm) {
+    // Use MPI's fixed-count algorithms when the partition is uniform.
+    if (positions.size() % counts.size() == 0) {
+        MPI_Allgather(MPI_IN_PLACE, 0, positionType, positions.data(), counts[0], positionType, comm);
+    } else {
+        MPI_Allgatherv(MPI_IN_PLACE, 0, positionType, positions.data(), counts.data(),
+                       offsets.data(), positionType, comm);
+    }

+void computeForceBlock(Body* bodies, const std::vector<Vec3>& positions) {
+    // SIMD lanes represent different target bodies. Each lane still accumulates
+    // sources in their original order, without a reordered floating-point sum.
+    constexpr size_t blockSize = FORCE_BLOCK_SIZE;
+        alignas(64) double x[blockSize], y[blockSize], z[blockSize];
+        alignas(64) double fx[blockSize] = {}, fy[blockSize] = {}, fz[blockSize] = {};
+        for (size_t lane = 0; lane < blockSize; ++lane) {
+            const auto& pos = bodies[lane].pos;
+            x[lane] = pos.x;
+            y[lane] = pos.y;
+            z[lane] = pos.z;
+        }
+        for (const auto& source : positions) {
+            for (size_t lane = 0; lane < blockSize; ++lane) {
+                const double dx = source.x - x[lane];
+                const double dy = source.y - y[lane];
+                const double dz = source.z - z[lane];
+                const double distSqr = dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + SOFTENING;
+                const double invDist = 1.0 / std::sqrt(distSqr);
+                const double invDist3 = invDist * invDist * invDist;
+                fx[lane] += dx * invDist3;
+                fy[lane] += dy * invDist3;
+                fz[lane] += dz * invDist3;
+            }
+        }
+        for (size_t lane = 0; lane < blockSize; ++lane) {
+            bodies[lane].vel.x += DT * fx[lane];
+            bodies[lane].vel.y += DT * fy[lane];
+            bodies[lane].vel.z += DT * fz[lane];
         }
-        
-        bodies[i].vel.x += DT * Fx;

-        bodies[i].vel.z += DT * Fz;
+}
+
+void computeForces(std::vector<Body>& bodies, const std::vector<Vec3>& positions) {
+    size_t i = 0;
+    for (; i + FORCE_BLOCK_SIZE <= bodies.size(); i += FORCE_BLOCK_SIZE) {
+        computeForceBlock(bodies.data() + i, positions);
     }
+    if (i < bodies.size()) {
+        // Duplicate a real target in unused lanes of the last block. Running
+        // the same kernel avoids different rounding in a scalar remainder.
+        const size_t lanes = bodies.size() - i;
+        Body tail[FORCE_BLOCK_SIZE];
+        for (size_t lane = 0; lane < FORCE_BLOCK_SIZE; ++lane) {
+            tail[lane] = bodies[i + std::min(lane, lanes - 1)];
+        }
+        computeForceBlock(tail, positions);
+        for (size_t lane = 0; lane < lanes; ++lane) bodies[i + lane].vel = tail[lane].vel;
+    }
 }

+void computeForces(std::vector<Body>& bodies, const std::vector<Vec3>& positions) {

#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cstring>
#include <exception>
#include <limits>
#include <type_traits>
#include <vector>

#include <mpi.h>

#include "../common/results_output.hpp"

constexpr double SOFTENING = 1e-9;
constexpr double DT = 0.01;
constexpr size_t FORCE_BLOCK_SIZE = 8;

struct Vec3 {
    double x, y, z;
    constexpr Vec3(const double x = 0, const double y = 0, const double z = 0) noexcept : x(x), y(y), z(z) {}
};

struct Body {
    Vec3 pos;
    Vec3 vel;
};

// The MPI datatypes below describe doubles, rather than transmitting raw bytes.
static_assert(std::is_standard_layout_v<Vec3> && sizeof(Vec3) == 3 * sizeof(double));
static_assert(std::is_standard_layout_v<Body> && sizeof(Body) == 6 * sizeof(double));

void randomizeBodies(std::vector<Body>& bodies, unsigned int seed = 42) {
    for (auto& body : bodies) {
        body.pos.x = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;
        body.pos.y = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;
        body.pos.z = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;
        body.vel.x = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;
        body.vel.y = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;
        body.vel.z = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;
    }
}

void exchangePositions(std::vector<Vec3>& positions, const std::vector<int>& counts,
                       const std::vector<int>& offsets, MPI_Datatype positionType, MPI_Comm comm) {
    // Use MPI's fixed-count algorithms when the partition is uniform.
    if (positions.size() % counts.size() == 0) {
        MPI_Allgather(MPI_IN_PLACE, 0, positionType, positions.data(), counts[0], positionType, comm);
    } else {
        MPI_Allgatherv(MPI_IN_PLACE, 0, positionType, positions.data(), counts.data(),
                       offsets.data(), positionType, comm);
    }
}

void computeForces(std::vector<Body>& bodies, const std::vector<Vec3>& positions) {
    // SIMD lanes represent different target bodies. Each lane still accumulates
    // sources in their original order, without a reordered floating-point sum.
    constexpr size_t blockSize = FORCE_BLOCK_SIZE;
    size_t i = 0;
    for (; i + blockSize <= bodies.size(); i += blockSize) {
        alignas(64) double x[blockSize], y[blockSize], z[blockSize];
        alignas(64) double fx[blockSize] = {}, fy[blockSize] = {}, fz[blockSize] = {};
        for (size_t lane = 0; lane < blockSize; ++lane) {
            x[lane] = bodies[i + lane].pos.x;
            y[lane] = bodies[i + lane].pos.y;
            z[lane] = bodies[i + lane].pos.z;
        }
        for (const auto& source : positions) {
            for (size_t lane = 0; lane < blockSize; ++lane) {
                const double dx = source.x - x[lane];
                const double dy = source.y - y[lane];
                const double dz = source.z - z[lane];
                const double distSqr = dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + SOFTENING;
                const double invDist = 1.0 / std::sqrt(distSqr);
                const double invDist3 = invDist * invDist * invDist;
                fx[lane] += dx * invDist3;
                fy[lane] += dy * invDist3;
                fz[lane] += dz * invDist3;
            }
        }
        for (size_t lane = 0; lane < blockSize; ++lane) {
            bodies[i + lane].vel.x += DT * fx[lane];
            bodies[i + lane].vel.y += DT * fy[lane];
            bodies[i + lane].vel.z += DT * fz[lane];
        }
    }

    for (; i < bodies.size(); ++i) {
        double fx = 0.0, fy = 0.0, fz = 0.0;
        for (const auto& source : positions) {
            const double dx = source.x - bodies[i].pos.x;
            const double dy = source.y - bodies[i].pos.y;
            const double dz = source.z - bodies[i].pos.z;
            const double distSqr = dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + SOFTENING;
            const double invDist = 1.0 / std::sqrt(distSqr);
            const double invDist3 = invDist * invDist * invDist;
            // Keep the fused accumulation used by the SIMD lanes instead of
            // allowing the compiler to vectorize a reduction over sources.
            fx = std::fma(dx, invDist3, fx);
            fy = std::fma(dy, invDist3, fy);
            fz = std::fma(dz, invDist3, fz);
        }
        const volatile double dvx = DT * fx;
        const volatile double dvy = DT * fy;
        const volatile double dvz = DT * fz;
        bodies[i].vel.x += dvx;
        bodies[i].vel.y += dvy;
        bodies[i].vel.z += dvz;
    }
}

void integrateBodies(std::vector<Body>& bodies, std::vector<Vec3>& positions, size_t first) {
    for (size_t i = 0; i < bodies.size(); ++i) {
        auto& body = bodies[i];
        body.pos.x += body.vel.x * DT;
        body.pos.y += body.vel.y * DT;
        body.pos.z += body.vel.z * DT;
        positions[first + i] = body.pos;
    }
}

double computeTotalEnergy(const std::vector<Body>& bodies, const std::vector<Vec3>& positions,
                          int rank, int ranks, MPI_Comm comm) {
    double energy = 0.0;
    const size_t n = positions.size();
    
    // Kinetic energy (assuming unit mass)
    for (const auto& body : bodies) {
        energy += 0.5 * (body.vel.x * body.vel.x + 
                        body.vel.y * body.vel.y + 
                        body.vel.z * body.vel.z);
    }
    
    // Potential energy (assuming unit mass for all bodies)
    // Cyclic ownership balances the triangular pair loop independently of the
    // contiguous body ownership used for the simulation.
    for (size_t i = static_cast<size_t>(rank); i < n; i += static_cast<size_t>(ranks)) {
        for (size_t j = i + 1; j < n; ++j) {
            const double dx = positions[j].x - positions[i].x;
            const double dy = positions[j].y - positions[i].y;
            const double dz = positions[j].z - positions[i].z;
            const double dist = std::sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + SOFTENING);
            energy -= 1.0 / dist;
        }
    }
    
    double totalEnergy = 0.0;
    MPI_Reduce(&energy, &totalEnergy, 1, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_SUM, 0, comm);
    return totalEnergy;
}

// Validate that simulation produces finite, reasonable values
long long validateSimulation(const std::vector<Body>& bodies, size_t first) {
    for (size_t i = 0; i < bodies.size(); ++i) {
        const auto& body = bodies[i];
        // Encoding the body index preserves the original first-failure message
        // when validation results from different ranks are combined with MIN.
        const long long failure = 3 * static_cast<long long>(first + i);
        // Check for NaN or Inf values
        if (!std::isfinite(body.pos.x) || !std::isfinite(body.pos.y) || !std::isfinite(body.pos.z) ||
            !std::isfinite(body.vel.x) || !std::isfinite(body.vel.y) || !std::isfinite(body.vel.z)) {
            return failure;
        }
        
        // Check for extreme values (bodies shouldn't fly off to infinity)
        const double maxPos = 1e6;
        const double maxVel = 1e6;
        if (std::abs(body.pos.x) > maxPos || std::abs(body.pos.y) > maxPos || std::abs(body.pos.z) > maxPos) {
            return failure + 1;
        }
        if (std::abs(body.vel.x) > maxVel || std::abs(body.vel.y) > maxVel || std::abs(body.vel.z) > maxVel) {
            return failure + 2;
        }
    }
    return std::numeric_limits<long long>::max();
}

void printUsage(const char* progName) {
    printf("Usage: %s [options]\n", progName);
    printf("Options:\n");
    printf("  -n <num>     Number of bodies (default: 1024)\n");
    printf("  -s <num>     Number of simulation steps (default: 10)\n");
    printf("  -v           Enable validation (checks energy conservation)\n");
    printf("  -r           Print results for external validation\n");
    printf("  -h           Show this help message\n");
}

int runSimulation(int argc, char** argv, int worldRank, int worldSize) {
    int numBodies = 1024;
    int numSteps = 10;
    bool validate = false;
    bool printResults = false;
    
    // Parse command line arguments
    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {
        if (strcmp(argv[i], "-n") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {
            numBodies = atoi(argv[++i]);
        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], "-s") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {
            numSteps = atoi(argv[++i]);
        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], "-v") == 0) {
            validate = true;
        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], "-r") == 0) {
            printResults = true;
        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], "-h") == 0) {
            if (worldRank == 0) printUsage(argv[0]);
            return 0;
        } else {
            if (worldRank == 0) {
                printf("Unknown option: %s\n", argv[i]);
                printUsage(argv[0]);
            }
            return 1;
        }
    }
    
    if (numBodies < 0) {
        if (worldRank == 0) printf("Number of bodies must be nonnegative\n");
        return 1;
    }
    if (worldRank == 0) {
        printf("N-Body Simulation\n");
        printf("Number of bodies: %d\n", numBodies);
        printf("Number of steps: %d\n", numSteps);
        printf("Validation: %s\n", validate ? "enabled" : "disabled");
    }

    // Ranks without bodies do not participate in per-step communication. Keep
    // rank zero active even for an empty simulation so it can produce output.
    const int ranks = std::max(1, std::min(numBodies, worldSize));
    MPI_Comm comm = MPI_COMM_WORLD;
    if (ranks < worldSize) {
        MPI_Comm_split(MPI_COMM_WORLD, worldRank < ranks ? 0 : MPI_UNDEFINED, worldRank, &comm);
        if (comm == MPI_COMM_NULL) return 0;
    }
    const int rank = worldRank;
    std::vector<int> counts(ranks), offsets(ranks);
    for (int r = 0; r < ranks; ++r) {
        counts[r] = numBodies / ranks + (r < numBodies % ranks ? 1 : 0);
        offsets[r] = r * (numBodies / ranks) + std::min(r, numBodies % ranks);
    }
    const size_t first = static_cast<size_t>(offsets[rank]);
    std::vector<Body> bodies(counts[rank]);
    std::vector<Vec3> positions(numBodies);

    MPI_Datatype positionType, bodyType;
    MPI_Type_contiguous(3, MPI_DOUBLE, &positionType);
    MPI_Type_commit(&positionType);
    MPI_Type_contiguous(2, positionType, &bodyType);
    MPI_Type_commit(&bodyType);
    {
        // Generate the original random stream once; scattering contiguous
        // segments keeps initialization independent of the number of ranks.
        std::vector<Body> initialBodies;
        if (rank == 0) {
            initialBodies.resize(numBodies);
            randomizeBodies(initialBodies);
        }
        MPI_Scatterv(initialBodies.data(), counts.data(), offsets.data(), bodyType,
                     bodies.data(), counts[rank], bodyType, 0, comm);
    }
    for (size_t i = 0; i < bodies.size(); ++i) positions[first + i] = bodies[i].pos;
    exchangePositions(positions, counts, offsets, positionType, comm);

    MPI_Barrier(comm);
    const double start = MPI_Wtime();
    
    for (int step = 0; step < numSteps; ++step) {
        computeForces(bodies, positions);
        integrateBodies(bodies, positions, first);
        // The final positions are exchanged only if validation needs them.
        if (step + 1 < numSteps) {
            exchangePositions(positions, counts, offsets, positionType, comm);
        }
    }
    
    const double elapsed = MPI_Wtime() - start;
    double duration = 0.0;
    MPI_Reduce(&elapsed, &duration, 1, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_MAX, 0, comm);
    if (rank == 0) printf("Simulation time: %lld ms\n", static_cast<long long>(duration * 1000.0));
    
    // Print results for external validation
    if (printResults) {
        // The packed MPI datatype and rank order reproduce the original body
        // serialization, including its hash and sample indexing.
        std::vector<double> bodyData(rank == 0 ? static_cast<size_t>(numBodies) * 6 : 0);
        MPI_Gatherv(bodies.data(), counts[rank], bodyType, bodyData.data(), counts.data(),
                    offsets.data(), bodyType, 0, comm);
        if (rank == 0) print_results(bodyData, "Bodies");
    }

    int result = 0;
    if (validate) {
        if (rank == 0) printf("Validating simulation results...\n");
        const long long localFailure = validateSimulation(bodies, first);
        long long failure;
        MPI_Allreduce(&localFailure, &failure, 1, MPI_LONG_LONG_INT, MPI_MIN, comm);
        if (failure == std::numeric_limits<long long>::max()) {
            if (numSteps > 0) {
                exchangePositions(positions, counts, offsets, positionType, comm);
            }
            const double finalEnergy = computeTotalEnergy(bodies, positions, rank, ranks, comm);
            if (rank == 0) {
                printf("Final energy: %.6f\n", finalEnergy);
                printf("Validation: PASSED\n");
            }
        } else {
            if (rank == 0) {
                const char* messages[] = {
                    "Validation failed: found NaN or Inf value in body state",
                    "Validation failed: body position exceeds reasonable bounds",
                    "Validation failed: body velocity exceeds reasonable bounds"
                };
                printf("%s\n", messages[failure % 3]);
                printf("Validation: FAILED\n");
            }
            result = 1;
        }
    }

    MPI_Type_free(&bodyType);
    MPI_Type_free(&positionType);
    if (comm != MPI_COMM_WORLD) MPI_Comm_free(&comm);
    return result;
}

int main(int argc, char** argv) {
    MPI_Init(&argc, &argv);
    int rank, ranks;
    MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &rank);
    MPI_Comm_size(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &ranks);
    int result = 1;
    try {
        result = runSimulation(argc, argv, rank, ranks);
    } catch (const std::exception& error) {
        fprintf(stderr, "Rank %d: %s\n", rank, error.what());
        // A failed allocation on one rank must not leave its peers blocked in
        // a collective operation.
        MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);
    }
    MPI_Finalize();
    return result;
}

+void computeForces(std::vector<Body>& bodies, const std::vector<Vec3>& positions) {
+    size_t i = 0;
+    for (; i + FORCE_BLOCK_SIZE <= bodies.size(); i += FORCE_BLOCK_SIZE) {

+    if (i < bodies.size()) {

+        const size_t lanes = bodies.size() - i;
+        Body tail[FORCE_BLOCK_SIZE];

codex
Implemented mandatory MPI parallelism, balanced body distribution, position-only exchanges, SIMD force calculations, and distributed validation. Only `nbody.cpp` and `CMakeLists.txt` changed; the executable remains `nbody`.

Tests matched the original state hashes with up to 8 ranks, including uneven partitions and edge cases. For 8,192 bodies over 5 steps, runtime on this host improved from **2,483 ms to 83 ms** with 8 ranks—about **30× faster**.

+void exchangePositions(std::vector<Vec3>& positions, const std::vector<int>& counts,
+                       const std::vector<int>& offsets, MPI_Datatype positionType, MPI_Comm comm) {
+    // Use MPI's fixed-count algorithms when the partition is uniform.
+    if (positions.size() % counts.size() == 0) {
+        MPI_Allgather(MPI_IN_PLACE, 0, positionType, positions.data(), counts[0], positionType, comm);
+    } else {
+        MPI_Allgatherv(MPI_IN_PLACE, 0, positionType, positions.data(), counts.data(),
+                       offsets.data(), positionType, comm);
+    }

+void computeForceBlock(Body* bodies, const std::vector<Vec3>& positions) {
+    // SIMD lanes represent different target bodies. Each lane still accumulates
+    // sources in their original order, without a reordered floating-point sum.
+    constexpr size_t blockSize = FORCE_BLOCK_SIZE;
+        alignas(64) double x[blockSize], y[blockSize], z[blockSize];
+        alignas(64) double fx[blockSize] = {}, fy[blockSize] = {}, fz[blockSize] = {};
+        for (size_t lane = 0; lane < blockSize; ++lane) {
+            const auto& pos = bodies[lane].pos;
+            x[lane] = pos.x;
+            y[lane] = pos.y;
+            z[lane] = pos.z;
+        }
+        for (const auto& source : positions) {
+            for (size_t lane = 0; lane < blockSize; ++lane) {
+                const double dx = source.x - x[lane];
+                const double dy = source.y - y[lane];
+                const double dz = source.z - z[lane];
+                const double distSqr = dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + SOFTENING;
+                const double invDist = 1.0 / std::sqrt(distSqr);
+                const double invDist3 = invDist * invDist * invDist;
+                fx[lane] += dx * invDist3;
+                fy[lane] += dy * invDist3;
+                fz[lane] += dz * invDist3;
+            }
+        }
+        for (size_t lane = 0; lane < blockSize; ++lane) {
+            bodies[lane].vel.x += DT * fx[lane];
+            bodies[lane].vel.y += DT * fy[lane];
+            bodies[lane].vel.z += DT * fz[lane];
         }
-        
-        bodies[i].vel.x += DT * Fx;
-        bodies[i].vel.y += DT * Fy;
-        bodies[i].vel.z += DT * Fz;
+}
+
+void computeForces(std::vector<Body>& bodies, const std::vector<Vec3>& positions) {
+    size_t i = 0;
+    for (; i + FORCE_BLOCK_SIZE <= bodies.size(); i += FORCE_BLOCK_SIZE) {
+        computeForceBlock(bodies.data() + i, positions);
     }
+    if (i < bodies.size()) {
+        // Duplicate a real target in unused lanes of the last block. Running
+        // the same kernel avoids different rounding in a scalar remainder.
+        const size_t lanes = bodies.size() - i;
+        Body tail[FORCE_BLOCK_SIZE];
+        for (size_t lane = 0; lane < FORCE_BLOCK_SIZE; ++lane) {
+            tail[lane] = bodies[i + std::min(lane, lanes - 1)];
+        }
+        computeForceBlock(tail, positions);
+        for (size_t lane = 0; lane < lanes; ++lane) bodies[i + lane].vel = tail[lane].vel;
+    }
 }
